integrity: The code performs finite exact boundary, rank, Smith, unimodular-minor, and graph-automorphism computations; no numerical extrapolation or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact for two unordered points on the specified sixteen-vertex graph; not an infinite-family theorem and no independent review. Equal or stronger unpublished literature remains a priority risk.
title: Girth-six product tori form an integral basis for two particles on the Möbius–Kantor graph
